name: redstart-twig-windows
description: Lightweight desktop chat client (Windows, macOS) for a Redstart Nest or llama.cpp-compatible server on your local network.
author: Patrick Carswell

scripts.build: npm run build:chat && node ../../redstart-nest/scripts/make-icon.mjs --variant twig && node ../../redstart-nest/scripts/stage-node.mjs && node ../../redstart-nest/scripts/rust-licenses.mjs --shell shell --out licenses/rust-licenses.json && node scripts/stage-shell-bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-shell.mjs
